name: Clicking a Round-of-16 cell navigates from homepage to a match detail page
description: When a visitor clicks any Round-of-16 cell in the bracket, the URL changes away from the homepage and the new page renders match detail content — proving R16 cells are real navigation, not visual stubs.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click a cell in the Round-of-16 area of the bracket
Verify the URL after the click differs from the homepage URL
Verify the destination page surfaces match-detail content — a kickoff time, venue, team name pair, or match identifier
